patterns.name: wazuh_correlated_ssh_brute_force
patterns.rationale: Wazuh rule 5712 correlates eight failed SSH logins from the same source within two minutes.

patterns.name: high_volume_password_guessing
patterns.rationale: High-severity T1110 alert with at least 15 failed attempts is a clear repeated-password guessing indicator in the supplied training fixture.

patterns.name: multi_account_password_spraying
patterns.rationale: A correlated high-severity alert showing repeated attempts across at least five distinct accounts indicates a spraying pattern without inspecting password values.

patterns.name: low_volume_suspicious_logins
patterns.rationale: Limited failed login attempts or contextual abnormalities warrant an alert, not an automatic block.

guardrails: The supplied lesson fixture uses rule.mitre as an array and data.count as a numeric string; never infer a count from rule.firedtimes.
Do not inspect or compare raw password values. A description mentioning password spraying is treated only as indicator metadata.
Routine low-severity success, logout and session events are record even if they contain normal account or IP fields.
Use a high severity AND attack evidence gate for blocks; a single failed authentication is not a block.
These thresholds are for the provided 28-event training fixture, not a general production security policy.
